capabilities: Open files in new tabs by default across links, quick switcher and file explorer
Switch to existing tabs instead of opening duplicate files, including across panes and popouts
Open tabs as VS Code-style preview tabs that are replaced until interacted with
Control placement of new tabs and which tab group they open in
Customize Ctrl/Cmd/middle-click behavior and toggle settings via commands
extras: Works by patching Obsidian's internal methods; the README notes most other similar plugins either work only in specific menus or have a timer delay before opening tabs.
intentEvidence: It is inspired by the Opener plugin which worked in a similar way, but is no longer maintained
problem: Obsidian opens files in the active tab by default, so users lose their open tabs and get duplicates, and workflows differ from editors like VS Code.

relations.evidence: It is inspired by the Opener plugin which worked in a similar way

summary: Tab behavior plugin that controls how Obsidian opens files across tabs, panes and popouts, with new-tab defaults, duplicate prevention and VS Code-style preview tabs.
